title: Moral Outrage Shapes Commitments Beyond Attention: Multimodal Moral Emotions on YouTube in Korea and the US
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and analyzing 'moral emotions' (such as moral outrage, other-praising, and other-suffering) in digital media content. It uses frameworks from moral psychology (specifically Haidt et al.) to categorize content and study how moral rhetoric influences user engagement and societal polarization.
